calls.title: Experiment Detail Page Walkthrough
calls.summary: The team discussed centralizing variation editing on the experimentation side while reusing existing JSON components for efficiency. Kari Kay proposed a streamlined variation editing modal to reduce UI complexity, while Bryce Fitzsimons emphasized maintaining consistency with the feature flag page. The approach involves restricting direct edits on the experiment page, with future integration planned. For linked feature flags, a separate modal will ensure all necessary values are set to prevent null states. The need for visibility of draft states on the experiment page was acknowledged to avoid accidental deployments. Additionally, separating metadata like screenshots from core configurations was deemed crucial for clarity, while focusing on reducing UI complexity and modal proliferation across the user experience.
calls.keywords: Variation Editing, Experiment Modal, Feature Flags, JSON Editing, Draft State, Environment Controls
calls.action_items:

**Bryce Fitzsimons**
